pages.text: For when the post should stand at my door and the field elsewhere. Sneak and use the $(item)cord$() on a post to take hold of it. It glows while it holds one.

pages.title: Linking
pages.text: Then, still sneaking: on a stock, basket, trough or cask, to join it to that post. On two corners of ground, to mark its field between them.$(br2)All within $(thing)11 blocks$() of the post and on its level. Motes show what is bound. Used on the same post again, the post forgets all of it.
